title: The First Stall
subtitle: The market's coin is amethyst, obviously
description: The market opens when you stop looking for it, and the first stall
sells nothing but change: four amethyst shards, the market's whole
currency, on the counter before you have agreed to anything.
The road in is dotted -- `dash: dotted`, the line for a road that
is a rumour -- and this quest draws it, so the market's one
sentence of line art is the sentence that fits.
